blocks.content: Computer hardware refers to the physical components of a computer system that can be seen and touched. Hardware performs the fundamental operations of input, processing, storage, and output. In this chapter we study important hardware components such as CPU, Motherboard, Ports, and Expansion Cards.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Central Processing Unit (CPU) serves as the primary processing unit, detailing essential components and operational functions.
The Motherboard houses main system components and enables critical inter-component communication.
Computer ports facilitate external hardware connections through various dedicated port types.
Expansion cards allow system modularity and hardware capability enhancement.

blocks.content: The Central Processing Unit (CPU) is the main processing component of a computer system. It is often called the 'brain of the computer' because it performs all calculations, logical operations, and controls the functioning of other hardware components.

cells: Performs arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) and logical comparisons.
Directs and coordinates all operations of the computer system and controls data flow.
Small high-speed storage locations used to temporarily store data during processing.

items: Executes program instructions.
Performs arithmetic and logical operations.
Controls and coordinates computer operations.
Manages data transfer between memory and input/output devices.
CPU is called the brain of the computer.
ALU performs arithmetic and logical operations.
CU controls the working of the entire computer.
Registers are the fastest memory inside CPU.

blocks.content: The motherboard is the main circuit board of a computer that connects all hardware components such as CPU, memory, storage devices, and peripheral devices.

items: CPU Socket – Holds the CPU.
RAM Slots – Used to install memory modules.
Chipset – Controls communication between CPU and other components.
Expansion Slots – Used to install expansion cards.
Power Connectors – Provide power supply to motherboard.
Connects all computer hardware components.
Allows communication between CPU, memory, and peripherals.
Provides slots for expansion cards.
Motherboard is the main circuit board of the computer.
All hardware components are connected through the motherboard.
Expansion slots are present on the motherboard.

blocks.content: Ports are connection points on a computer that allow external devices to communicate with the system.

items: Key questions frequently test the specific functions and architectural components of the CPU.
Motherboard components and their primary functions are common high-yield exam topics.
Distinction between various hardware ports and expansion card types is regularly asked in competitive exams.

blocks.content: Expansion cards are circuit boards inserted into expansion slots on the motherboard to enhance the functionality of a computer.
